video_title: [TJ & Rudy] Did A Great Job Finding Their Flow Tonight." | Chris Finch Post Game Sound | 11.16.26

quotes.speaker: Chris Finch
quotes.summary_phrase: Chris Finch praises TJ's offensive performance and playmaking
quotes.excerpt: he was definitely the MVP tonight offensively for sure, did a good job defensively as well.
quotes.quote: He got downhill, put a lot of pressure on them, got to the free throw line a ton, softened up their defense a little bit, made shots, he found himself in a rhythm. He was definitely the MVP tonight offensively for sure, did a good job defensively as well.
quotes.social_post: Chris Finch calls TJ the MVP of tonight's game offensively, noting he got downhill, pressured the defense, and found a rhythm.

structured.context: Head coach Chris Finch discusses the offensive performance of TJ following a Timberwolves game.

quotes.speaker: Chris Finch
quotes.summary_phrase: Chris Finch explains what makes TJ effective at the rim
quotes.excerpt: you got to have a high motor, first of all, and you got to have a quick burst.
quotes.quote: You got to have a high motor, first of all, and you got to have a quick burst, and he does a good job of changing speeds. I think that's a big key for him is to change speeds. His playmaking was great too, he had six assists and he actually triggered a lot of really good offense in the first half, multiple driving kick sequences when we were really struggling to find something.
quotes.social_post: Chris Finch breaks down what makes TJ effective at the rim, highlighting his high motor, quick burst, and ability to change speeds.

structured.context: Chris Finch explains the specific skills and playmaking abilities that make TJ effective on the court.

quotes.speaker: Chris Finch
quotes.summary_phrase: Chris Finch on Rudy Gobert's offensive involvement and rebounding
quotes.excerpt: we challenged Rudy, he needed to get back to being stronger around the rim.
quotes.quote: We challenged Rudy, he needed to get back to being stronger around the rim. He needed to get back to dominating like he can do. We were looking for him and they got their hands on a lot of passes early on, and we were able to find a few clear windows, but he did a good job of getting on the glass and keeping things alive too.
quotes.social_post: Chris Finch says the team challenged Rudy Gobert to be stronger around the rim and dominate like he is capable of doing.

structured.context: Chris Finch comments on Rudy Gobert's performance around the rim and his contribution on the glass.

quotes.speaker: Chris Finch
quotes.summary_phrase: Chris Finch on Rudy Gobert's ability to overcome adversity
quotes.excerpt: he has an incredible pride and he knows when he hasn't played well.
quotes.quote: There's two things. One is he's an incredible player, and the second thing is he has an incredible pride and he knows when he hasn't played well and he takes ownership over that and he holds himself accountable and he gets back to being the guy that he knows he can be and we know we need him to be.
quotes.social_post: Chris Finch praises Rudy Gobert's accountability, saying he has incredible pride and knows when he hasn't played up to his standard.

structured.context: Chris Finch praises Rudy Gobert for his accountability and ability to bounce back after poor performances.

quotes.speaker: Chris Finch
quotes.summary_phrase: Chris Finch remains confident in LaMelo's shooting ability
quotes.excerpt: I'm not worried about it, this will turn around, he'll make shots.
quotes.quote: I thought he got for the most part a lot of really good looks. Even the other night, the looks that he took in the Chicago game weren't bad looks, it's just that they could have been at the expense of maybe some driving and finish opportunities. I do think there's some of that there for him, but I'm not worried about it, this will turn around, he'll make shots.
quotes.social_post: Chris Finch says he is not worried about LaMelo's shooting struggles, stating he is confident the shots will start falling soon.

structured.context: Chris Finch discusses LaMelo Ball's recent shooting struggles and expresses confidence in his ability to improve.

quotes.speaker: Chris Finch
quotes.summary_phrase: Chris Finch on the strategy against rim protectors like Clingan
quotes.excerpt: you got to make him commit one way or the other.
quotes.quote: You got to make him commit one way or the other. He's down there. I was really pleased we called defensive three seconds, two of them, you never see that, so we could have called one almost every time down really. But you got to make him commit and then try to find the avenues to pass around him. You're not going to finish over him all night long.
quotes.social_post: Chris Finch on the strategy against rim protectors like Clingan: You have to make them commit one way or the other because you are not going to finish over them all night.

structured.context: Chris Finch explains the strategic approach the team took to score against rim protector Donovan Clingan.

quotes.speaker: Chris Finch
quotes.summary_phrase: Chris Finch on slowing down Avdija in the second half
quotes.excerpt: we did a really good job of picking good routes.
quotes.quote: We did a really good job of picking good routes. I thought in the first half we were too detached from him and then he was able to make a little move and get to where he wanted to go. We got into him a little bit more physical, I thought Rudy was up a little bit more, slowed him down a little bit more, wasn't able to get a runway a lot of times.
quotes.social_post: Chris Finch explains the defensive adjustment on Avdija in the second half, noting the team got more physical and Rudy played higher up.

structured.context: Chris Finch describes the defensive adjustments made to limit Deni Avdija in the second half.

quotes.speaker: Chris Finch
quotes.summary_phrase: Chris Finch on the importance of guard rebounding
quotes.excerpt: our guards have to rebound at a high level.
quotes.quote: We know that how important rebounding is for us this year. Our guards have to rebound at a high level. I think TJ's defensive rebound, he only has two here, but I know he got his hands on a lot of things, kept a lot of things alive for us to track down other ways. As long as his activity is high, he's a really good rebounder on both ends of the floor.
quotes.social_post: Chris Finch emphasizes the importance of guard rebounding, noting that TJ's high activity level is crucial for the team's success.

structured.context: Chris Finch emphasizes the importance of guard rebounding and highlights TJ's activity on the glass.

quotes.speaker: Chris Finch
quotes.summary_phrase: Chris Finch on the impact of new roster additions
quotes.excerpt: these are guys that Tim Connelly has done a great job with.
quotes.quote: These are guys that Tim Connelly has done a great job with, has a high degree of familiarity with. He knows that he feels that they'll fit well and these guys have been great. We're getting these guys with a chip on their shoulder too, something to prove and re-prove themselves and that's exactly where you want guys like that.
quotes.social_post: Chris Finch says the new roster additions have a chip on their shoulder and something to prove, which is exactly what the team needs.

structured.context: Chris Finch credits executive Tim Connelly for the successful acquisition of new roster additions.
